label: Chest or heart space
prompt: Rest your attention on your chest or heart space. Notice breath depth, expansion, or pulsing.

options.title: Weighted or pressured
options.insight: Weight or pressure here can reflect grief, sadness, or responsibility carried for others.

options.title: Tight or constricted
options.note: Band squeezing, armor, or breath held high
options.insight: Tightness across the chest can accompany your system bracing for threat or overwhelm.

options.title: Pounding or racing heartbeat
options.note: Heart racing, flutter, sudden surges of beats
options.insight: A pounding heart can point to activation—anxiety, fear, anger, or eager anticipation.

options.title: Open, warm, or expansive
options.note: Soft chest, easy breathing, gentle warmth
options.insight: An open chest can accompany calm, relief, or joyful connection.

label: Stomach or gut
prompt: Soften awareness into your belly. Notice flips, hollowness, or steadiness.

options.title: Hollow or empty
options.insight: Emptiness in the gut can flag sadness, loneliness, or grief.

options.title: Nausea or queasy
options.note: Churned up, unsettled, urge to vomit
options.insight: Nausea can show up when something feels unsafe, overwhelming, or not right.

options.title: Rolling or fluttering
options.insight: Rolling sensations can blend anxious worry with hopeful excitement about what is next.

options.title: Settled or warm
options.insight: Warmth in the belly can match calm confidence or gentle hope.

label: Throat and voice
prompt: Bring attention to your throat and voice box. Notice tightness, urge to speak, or dryness.

options.title: Tight or gripped
options.insight: A tight throat can appear when sadness, anxiety, or shame holds words back.

options.title: Lump or swelling
options.note: Tears hovering, voice shaking, lump rising
options.insight: A lump in the throat can pair with grief, loneliness, or tenderness seeking expression.

options.title: Dry or closed off
options.note: Scratchy, hard to speak, voice fades
options.insight: Dryness can indicate fear or anticipation about speaking up.

options.title: Gag or urge to retch
options.note: Gag reflex, throat closing, increased saliva
options.insight: Gagging or throat closing is a classic disgust response.

label: Jaw, mouth, or fists
prompt: Notice your jaw, tongue, and hands. Are they loose, braced, or buzzing?

options.title: Tremble or quiver
options.note: Jaw shaking, lips or hands quivering
options.insight: Trembling around the mouth can accompany fear, overwhelm, or sadness releasing.

options.title: Clenched or grinding
options.note: Teeth locked, fists tight, rigid tongue
options.insight: Clenched muscles can reflect anger, frustration, or determined resolve.

options.title: Heat or flush
options.note: Warm cheeks, heat pooling in jaw
options.insight: Heat in the jaw can mark anger, shame, or a boundary flare.

label: Head and mind space
prompt: Check your forehead, temples, and behind the eyes. Notice pressure, buzzing, or fog.

options.title: Foggy or heavy
options.note: Hard to focus, thick clouded feeling
options.insight: Fog can appear with exhaustion, low mood, or protective numbness.

options.title: Pressure or band
options.insight: Head pressure can signal mental load, stress, or overwhelm asking for relief.

options.title: Buzzing or static
options.insight: Buzzing in the head can come with anxious energy or excited anticipation.

label: Shoulders and upper back
prompt: Sense the slope of your shoulders and upper back. Notice if they lift, droop, or carry weight.

options.title: Weighted or burdened
options.note: Heavy load, sagging posture, tight knots
options.insight: Weighted shoulders can align with stress, guilt, or sadness about responsibility.

options.title: Drooping or collapsed
options.insight: Drooping shoulders can reflect fatigue, discouragement, or grief.

options.title: Lifted or braced
options.insight: Braced shoulders can show your body gearing up—anxiety, determination, or anger.

label: Arms, hands, or legs
prompt: Let awareness move through arms and legs. Notice heaviness, restlessness, or tingles.

options.title: Heavy or lead-like
options.insight: Heavy limbs can show tiredness, sadness, or numb shutdown.

options.title: Tingly or sparkly
options.insight: Tingles can mean excited anticipation or anxious vigilance.

options.title: Restless or fidgety
options.note: Urge to pace, bounce, or shake
options.insight: Restless pacing can accompany anger as energy mobilizes for action.

label: Temperature shifts
prompt: Notice any sudden changes in temperature or skin sensation.

options.title: Chill or cold rush
options.insight: Chills may signal fear, anxiety, or grief moving through.

options.title: Prickly or sweaty skin
options.insight: Adrenaline in fear can produce cold sweat and skin prickles.

options.title: Flush of heat
options.insight: Heat waves can pair with anger, excitement, or shame.

label: Whole-body sense
prompt: Step back and notice the overall tone of your body right now.

options.title: Floating or unreal
options.note: Drifting, spaced out, not quite here
options.insight: Floating sensations can hint at overwhelm or anxiety pulling you away from the moment.

options.title: Muted or numb
options.insight: Numbness can be protective when overwhelm maxes out.

options.title: Grounded or calm
options.insight: Steady calm can mean needs feel met—contentment, gratitude, or relief.
